question: What is the primary medical benefit of Female Genital Mutilation (FGM)?

options.B: There are no medical benefits to the procedure

explanation: Spot on! FGM is done purely for traditional or cultural reasons—it has zero health benefits for the body. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T4#GNS312_U1_T4_h1)

question: Which part of the body is directly injured during the practice of FGM?
explanation: You got it! FGM involves cutting or altering the external female genital structures. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T4#GNS312_U1_T4_h1)

question: Why do some communities continue to practice FGM across generations?

options.A: Local religious texts explicitly command the surgery
options.B: Modern scientific journals endorse the procedure
options.C: It is viewed as a vital cultural rite of passage
options.D: Government health laws strongly mandate the practice

explanation: Correct! Communities hold onto FGM because it is deeply tied to their traditional customs and transition ceremonies. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T4#GNS312_U1_T4_h2)

question: What is a common social penalty for a family that refuses FGM in a pro-FGM community?
explanation: That's right. Families who break this tradition often face intense rejection and loneliness from people around them. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T4#GNS312_U1_T4_h2)

question: What is a major psychological reason behind performing FGM on young girls?

options.B: Controlling and reducing female sexual desire
options.C: Increasing natural hormonal balance in adults

explanation: Spot on! The practice is often used to suppress a woman's libido and enforce strict chastity. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T4#GNS312_U1_T4_h3)

question: How do traditional beliefs often mischaracterize women who have not undergone FGM?

options.A: As being unable to bear healthy children
options.B: As being hypersexual and prone to promiscuity
options.C: As lacking basic community survival skills
options.D: As suffering from chronic physical weakness

explanation: Correct! Cultural myths wrongly claim that unoperated women cannot control their sexual urges. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T4#GNS312_U1_T4_h3)

question: What is the true relationship between FGM and major world religions?

options.A: Christian scriptures require the procedure for moral purity
options.B: FGM is a cultural practice falsely linked to religious texts
options.C: The Holy Quran explicitly commands all families to perform FGM
options.D: Islamic law strictly forbids any form of traditional surgery

explanation: Well done! Major religious books do not command FGM—the link is just a cultural misconception. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T4#GNS312_U1_T4_h4)

question: Why do some families mistakenly believe their religion requires FGM?

options.A: Holy books contain detailed anatomical drawings
options.B: Clergy members check medical records during weekly services
options.C: Religious schools teach the surgical steps to students
options.D: Local elders falsely claim scriptures demand it for modesty

explanation: Exactly! Misinterpretations from community leaders make people think this harmful custom is a spiritual duty. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T4#GNS312_U1_T4_h4)

question: Why is FGM often linked to a young girl's future marriage prospects in some societies?

options.A: Uncut women are frequently labeled unmarriageable by local standards
options.B: Traditional wedding planners refuse to work with uncut families
options.C: Local marriage laws forbid ceremonies for unaltered brides
options.D: Grooms require medical certificates proving childhood surgery

explanation: Spot on! Community stigma says only cut women are worthy of marriage, pressuring families to comply. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T4#GNS312_U1_T4_h5)

question: How does the pressure for marriageability drive the continuation of FGM?

options.A: Grooms pay higher bride prices directly to local surgeons
options.B: Traditional courts confiscate property from unmarried households
options.C: Community leaders fine families who delay the wedding ceremony
options.D: Parents fear their daughters will face poverty and isolation without a husband

explanation: Correct! Because women often rely on marriage for survival, parents allow FGM to protect their children's futures. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T4#GNS312_U1_T4_h5)

question: What is a common myth used to justify FGM regarding hygiene?

options.A: Clipping the tissue improves daily personal hygiene efficiency
options.B: Uncut female genitalia are considered dirty and masculine
options.C: Surgical removal prevents all future skin infections
options.D: Natural anatomy causes unpleasant odors during adolescence

explanation: You got it! A widespread cultural myth falsely labels natural female anatomy as unclean. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T4#GNS312_U1_T4_h6)

question: What is the actual impact of FGM on childbirth, contrary to traditional beliefs?

options.A: Delivery times become much shorter and completely painless
options.B: The procedure permanently cures all forms of primary infertility
options.C: Scar tissue obstructs labor and increases childbirth risks
options.D: Hormonal levels rise significantly to support healthy pregnancies

explanation: Spot on! Instead of helping, FGM creates tough scar tissue that causes serious complications during delivery. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T4#GNS312_U1_T4_h6)

question: Which of these is a direct clinical duty for a nurse caring for an FGM survivor?

options.A: Performing corrective cosmetic surgeries in outpatient wards
options.B: Managing chronic pain and obstetric complications
options.C: Isolating the patient from traditional community networks
options.D: Reporting family members immediately to international courts

explanation: Correct! As a nurse, you provide physical and emotional care for the lasting health issues caused by the procedure. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T4#GNS312_U1_T4_h7)

question: What is the best way for a nurse to approach a community health program against FGM?

options.A: Avoid discussing the topic to prevent offending local traditions
options.B: Distribute dense medical research journals to every household
options.C: Scold village elders publicly for practicing barbaric customs
options.D: Explain physiological harms respectfully while engaging community leaders

explanation: Well done! Effective prevention relies on respectful, open dialogue that partners with local influencers. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T4#GNS312_U1_T4_h7)
